about: The height of the ground round Kowloon Walled City, as in December 1986, out to 640 m from the centre of the plan box. src/terrain.js reads it.
notice: Contains data from the Government of the Hong Kong SAR: the Lands Department 5 m Digital Terrain Model and the 1:1000 survey sheet 11-NE-11A (May 1987). See data/CONTEXT-NOTICE.md.
frame: plan: x and z as in data/context.json, origin at the centre of the plan box; heights in metres above Principal Datum (mPD)

source.dtm: LandsD Digital Terrain Model, 5 m grid (Whole_HK_DTM_5m.asc, 2019-03-11), https://data.gov.hk/en-data/dataset/hk-landsd-openmap-5m-grid-dtm
source.spots: LandsD 1:1000 survey sheet 11-NE-11A, edition 11, May 1987: spot heights read by eye

method.city: INFERRED: inside the City the ground is the grid of today smoothed; no 1987 survey gives a height inside the City.
